offering_description.value: Operates a franchise network providing temporary staffing, permanent placement and executive recruitment to employers.

primary_services.value: Temporary staffing; direct-hire recruitment; executive search; staffing franchise support

items.detail: Employers seeking temporary workers or permanent hires; staffing franchise operators

end_markets.value: Construction; manufacturing; warehousing and logistics; hospitality; office administration; professional employment

items.detail: Franchise operators pay royalties for staffing brands and operating systems
Employer payments for temporary staffing and successful permanent placements support the franchise network
Connects workers with employers through franchised staffing and recruitment offices and supplies operating support to franchisees

geography_served.detail: Staffing franchise network across the United States

company_size.value: National staffing franchisor with an extensive office network serving local employers and broader corporate accounts

specialization.detail: Temporary labor, commercial staffing, professional recruitment and executive search share employer relationships and recruitment capabilities

items.detail: Franchised staffing offices develop employer relationships and deliver recruitment services
Staffing representatives sell directly to employers

regulatory_exposure.detail: Staffing operations face federal and state wage, employment, worker classification, workplace safety and workers' compensation rules, including Department of Labor and OSHA requirements

notes: The current geographic footprint and mix of franchise royalties versus directly earned staffing fees are uncertain without website material.
